stories.title: Man jailed for damaging Belfast's Big Fish
stories.summary: A man has been jailed for five months after causing an estimated £10,000 worth of damage to Belfast's Big Fish sculpture.

stories.title: 'Inconceivable' that Irish government would not hold Omagh inquiry - Sir Chris Bryant
stories.summary: The Omagh Bombing Inquiry is investigating whether the attack on 15 August 1998, in which 29 people including a woman pregnant with twins were killed, could have been prevented.

stories.title: 'Dad was deteriorating': Two-hour ambulance target missed more than 2,000 times
stories.summary: The Release to Rescue initiative was introduced this year to cut ambulance delays and speed up handover times.

stories.title: Magill returns to NI squad for Greece friendlies
stories.summary: Northern Ireland manager Michael McArdle has made five changes to his squad for the upcoming friendlies against Greece, with the return of experienced striker Simone Magill among the notable returnees.

stories.title: 'Someone will be killed or seriously injured' - mum's warning after car ramming
stories.summary: Laura Moore's husband and son were in her car when it was rammed by another driver in Derry on Saturday night.

stories.title: 'Time and money wasted' as police sent to court without testifying
stories.summary: Police and other experts are "routinely" taken away from other work to attend court, a report finds.

stories.title: Minister criticises Belfast IT firm's notification delay over credit unions data breach
stories.summary: Robert Troy said about 40 Irish credit unions are affected by the breach, which is believed to be linked to Wellington IT, a firm based in Belfast.

stories.title: Pope prays with families of the Disappeared during special audience
stories.summary: Family members attended a special audience with the Pope in St Peter's Square.

stories.title: Man jailed for recording female colleagues using toilet
stories.summary: David O'Hara, 44, of Sea Coast Road in Limavady, had previously pleaded guilty to voyeurism by planting a camera in a unisex toilet.

stories.title: Driver pleads guilty to causing deaths of married couple and friend
stories.summary: Josh McGleenan of Ashveagh in Benburb had been due to go on trial at Newry Crown Court on Tuesday for causing the deaths of three people.

stories.title: 'Good for the people' if politicians stopped doing media, says NI secretary
stories.summary: Sir Chris Bryant said all that "talking to the media emphasises the divisions rather than the collaborations".

stories.title: 'Nightmare' to save as average semi-detached house price hits 19-year high
stories.summary: The effects of inflation means that houses are still substantially cheaper in real terms today.
